Context: 10. Paternity Leave

## 10. Paternity Leave  
Male Government servant with less than two surviving children during the confinement of his wife for childbirth or on accepting a child in pre-adoption foster care or on valid adoption of a child below the  
Eligibility: age of one year. Apprentices are also eligible.  
Fifteen days during wife's confinement, i.e., up to 15 days before, or up to six months from the date of delivery of the child and for 15 days within six months from the date of accepting the child in pre-adoption
